notes: Health Canada (Jan 2026) warns not to buy or use unauthorized or counterfeit GLP-1 products; buy only from licensed pharmacies with a prescription.

Health Canada's 2026 safety review found a possible link between GLP-1 receptor agonists and pulmonary aspiration during general anesthesia or deep sedation; all GLP-1 RA monographs are being updated.
